command.description: Run a project-local command during setup, diagnostics, or headless proof. Prefer UI actions only when the recipe must prove visible interaction.

app.status.description: Query the dev-only Farmslot Expo bridge to confirm the app is reachable.

app.hud.description: Display one concise human intent line from the current recipe node.

app.trace.description: Emit a lightweight bridge trace event for recipe timeline observability.

ui.press.description: Press a native app control through the simulator or device assigned to this Farmslot slot; live runs require slot device context.

ui.wait_for.description: Wait for native accessibility content on the simulator or device assigned to this Farmslot slot; live runs require slot device context.

ui.screenshot.description: Capture the assigned simulator or device into the recipe artifact package; live runs require slot device context.

index_artifacts.description: Copy generated screenshot artifacts into the recipe artifact package for review.

observers.description: Current native app identity recorded after supported UI actions.
Bounded native accessibility targets visible after supported UI actions.
